name: 08-baseline-chase-14a1d61
description: Pre-dawn: the night pipeline falls fast to ~284 while the day pipeline is still dark (4000). The brightening probe fires early and FAILS, and the post-revert pre-baseline window re-probes once more (the a5dae07 path) - two failed pairs, backoff at the x4 cap, ratchet latched near 284 with its 60% bar (~170) under the 256 floor (the unsatisfiable-bar warn must fire). The baseline then chases the day-level gain down to ~262, dragging the skip gate's 'solidly night' bar with it, so pre-14a1d61 the periodic reconfirm was skipped indefinitely - two verify-before-trusting mechanisms validating each other - and only probe_max_skip_s (pushed to 7200 here so it cannot mask the fix under test) would recover. Post-fix the ratchet ANCHOR (a frozen measurement, immune to the chase) sees gain below 97% of the failed probe's level and forces the periodic probe through at its x4 deadline (~3980s); the day pipeline reads 250 and day sticks. The restart-equivalence bound is deliberately backoff-cap-aware (3800s > 4x reconfirm): tightening it to one reconfirm interval is exactly what the dn_next_probe() collapse is for.

expect_log: brighten ratchet bar 1\d\d is below the sensor gain floor
